PUBLIC SERVICES COMMITTEE
MINUTES

Due to the President's Day holiday, a meeting of the Public Services Committee was instead held
on Wednesday, February 22, 2023, in Committee Room 104 and via electronic meeting, starting
at 12:00 p.m. Those in attendance were as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Bryan Cook, Chairman, Pete Laybourn, Dr. Mark Rinne and Tom
Segrave.

8. ORDINANCE -3" READING — Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, land
located southwest of the intersection of Ridge Road and Holland Court. (POSTPONED
FROM 02-13-23)

Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 3 and final reading, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

Seth Lloyd, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and Brad Emmons, AVI
P.C., provided additional information. Committee member Rinne provided clarification regarding
approval of the annexation ordinance and the zoning ordinance. Councilwoman Aldrich, Ward
III, commented on the item. Public comments on the item were made by Peggy Escamilla, Charles
Marsh, and Wendy Volk.

9. ORDINANCE -3" READING — Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from County A-1 Agriculture and Rural
Residential to NR-3 Neighborhood Residential-High Density for land located southwest of
the intersection of Ridge Road and Holland Court. (POSTPONED FROM 02-13-23)

Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 3" and final reading, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Dr. Rinne moved
to postpone until the March 13, 2023 meeting of the governing body. Motion to postpone died
due to the lack of a second. Main motion failed with Mr. Laybourn and Dr. Rinne voting “NO”
and Mr. Segrave voting “YES”.

Seth Lloyd, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and Tom Cobb, City
Engineer, provided additional information. Brad Emmons, AVI P.C., and Jason Stephen, Gateway
Construction provided additional information. Committee members Laybourn, Rinne and Segrave
commented on the item, Public comments on the item were made by Roger Alexander, Cindy
Anderson, Steve Borin, John Cecil, Peggy Escamilla, Mat Kasper, Jason Gillespie, Charles Marsh,
Rebecca Murchie, Elizabeth Steeple, Ron Stone, and Wendy Volk.
